200.description:

Naming one pipeline (or company) also returns its annual financial series: revenue, cost of service, net income, rate base, return on equity and more.

| `company` | string | CER-regulated company. |
| `facility_documents_url` | string | REGDOCS folder of facility applications. |
| `financial_regulation_group` | string | `Group 1` (full) or `Group 2` (complaint-basis) financial regulation. |

| `location` | string | Route description. |

| `parent_company` | string |  |

| `slug` | string | Program slug for `throughput` and `tolls`; null for a system this program has no files for. |

Pipeline throughput and capacity at a CER-regulated system's key points, from the CER's Pipeline Throughput and Capacity open data (the numbers behind the Pipeline Profiles traffic charts): natural gas systems daily (returned as monthly averages unless `granularity` is `daily`), oil systems monthly by product. Each row has throughput and capacity in thousand m3/d, GJ/d for gas, committed and available capacity and the reason for variance for oil, and utilization. Filter by key point, product, trade type and date; newest first, paged. 19 systems: NGTL, TC Canadian Mainline, Westcoast, Alliance, Foothills, M&NP, TQM, Brunswick, Suffield, Trans Mountain, Enbridge Mainline, Line 9, Keystone, Cochin, Trans-Northern, Southern Lights, Norman Wells, Westspur and Montreal.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `available_capacity_1000m3d` | number | Oil: available capacity, thousand m3/d. |
| `capacity_1000m3d` | number | Gas: operational capacity; oil: nameplate capacity, thousand m3/d. |
| `committed_1000m3d` | number | Oil systems with firm service: committed volumes. |
| `date` | string | Day (daily) or first of the month (monthly), ISO. |
| `days` | number | Monthly gas rows: days averaged; null otherwise. |
| `direction_of_flow` | string |  |
| `key_point` | string |  |
| `product` | string | Oil systems: product class such as `domestic heavy`; null for gas. |
| `reason_for_variance` | string | Oil: why available capacity is below nameplate. |
| `throughput_1000m3d` | number | Throughput in thousand cubic metres per day (monthly gas rows: the daily average). |
| `throughput_gj_d` | number | Gas: throughput in GJ/d. |
| `trade_type` | string |  |
| `uncommitted_1000m3d` | number |  |
| `utilization_pct` | number | Throughput over available capacity (else capacity), percent. |

200.description:
Tolls on a CER-regulated pipeline from the CER's Major Canadian Natural Gas and Oil Pipeline Tolls open data, collapsed from the CER's daily rows into effective periods: path, service, product, toll and unit, effective from and to, whether it is current, the tariff number it came from and replaced, and the REGDOCS folder and document ids of the tariff filing. Filter by path, service, product, current tolls only, or a date window; newest first, paged. Every answer also lists the system's paths, services and products. 25 systems, including Trans Mountain, Keystone, Enbridge Mainline, NGTL, TC Mainline, Westcoast, Alliance, Express and Cochin.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `tolls` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effective_from` | string | First day this toll and tariff applied, ISO. |
| `effective_to` | string | Last day it applied, ISO. |
| `is_current` | boolean | In force on the newest date in the file. |
| `path` | string | Route or zone, e.g. `Edmonton to Westridge`, `Receipt`, `Group 1`. |
| `product` | string |  |
| `regdocs_document_id` | string | REGDOCS document id. |
| `regdocs_document_url` | string | REGDOCS download of the tariff document. |
| `regdocs_folder_id` | string | REGDOCS item id of that folder. |
| `regdocs_folder_url` | string | REGDOCS filing folder of the tariff. |
| `replaces_tariff_number` | string |  |
| `service` | string |  |
| `tariff_number` | string |  |
| `toll` | number |  |
| `unit` | string | e.g. `CN$/m3`, `$/103m3/mo`. |
